scope: Auto bonus-casts offer dialog (fishing) after last daily cast: auto-open timing, decline/reopen, exhausted-on-load, hidden during legendary catch cinematic/reward, all-ads-used / mode-off suppression, web-browser suppression, regression

checks.criterion: Auto bonus window after last free cast (simulated iOS, used 14->15, bonus_casts 0, escaped reel, my_ad_reward_state test mode left 2/2)
checks.name: fishing-bonus-offer-auto-open-after-last-cast
checks.evidence: On load with used=14 fishing-bonus-offer count=0. After cast+reel (escaped), fishing-result visible and dialog still count=0 immediately (card animating). Within 4s dialog becomes visible with exactly 1 instance: title '🎣 KEINE ANGELVERSUCHE MEHR!', description text present, fishing-bonus-offer-watch text '🎬 WERBUNG ANSEHEN – +5 FÄNGE', fishing-bonus-offer-decline 'Nein danke', fishing-bonus-offer-left contains '2 von 2'.

checks.criterion: 'Nein danke' closes; re-open from counter and from limit message button
checks.name: fishing-bonus-offer-decline-and-reopen
checks.evidence: Decline click removes fishing-bonus-offer (count 0). After closing the result card, fishing-bonus-offer-open (header counter button) is visible, reopens the dialog; declining again and then clicking fishing-limit-offer-button inside fishing-limit-message also reopens it.

checks.criterion: Not shown on plain page load when already exhausted (used=15/bonus=0 from the start)
checks.name: fishing-bonus-offer-not-shown-on-load-exhausted
checks.evidence: fishing-limit-message visible on load, fishing-bonus-offer count=0; fishing-bonus-offer-open and fishing-limit-offer-button both visible and reopen the dialog on click.

checks.criterion: Legendary catch: no bonus window during video or reward screen; appears after continuing
checks.name: fishing-bonus-offer-hidden-during-legendary-catch
checks.evidence: Reel returns species_id leonida_marlin. While fishing-catch-video-overlay is active, fishing-bonus-offer count=0. After skip, fishing-legendary-catch reward screen shown, dialog still count=0. After clicking fishing-legendary-continue, fishing-bonus-offer becomes visible within 3s.

checks.criterion: All ad offers used (bonus.used=2) or mode 'off' -> no dialog, no reopen buttons, limit message shows exhausted text
checks.name: fishing-bonus-offer-all-ads-used-no-dialog
checks.evidence: With bonus.used=2/limit=2 and separately mode='off', fishing-bonus-offer/-open/fishing-limit-offer-button all count=0; fishing-limit-message text equals 'Alle Angelversuche für heute verbraucht. Morgen kannst du wieder angeln!' in both cases.

checks.criterion: Web browser (no native shim), used=15 bonus=0: no dialog, no ad buttons, my_ad_reward_state never called
checks.name: fishing-bonus-offer-web-browser-exhausted-no-dialog
checks.evidence: No Capacitor/webkit shim added. fishing-bonus-offer/-open/fishing-limit-offer-button all count=0; my_ad_reward_state route flag never set true; fishing-limit-message shows the 'Alle Angelversuche...' text.

checks.criterion: Regression: existing fishing* and neoshop-bait* checks still pass (limit text updated per spec_deviations)
checks.name: fishing-daily-limit-reached-mocked + fishing-no-ad-rewards-in-web-browser + fishing-bonus-casts-not-locked + neoshop-baits-tab-purchase-mocked
checks.evidence: Updated fishing-daily-limit-reached-mocked.mjs expectation to the new web text 'Alle Angelversuche für heute verbraucht. Morgen kannst du wieder angeln!' (old 'Deine 15 Angelversuche...sind aufgebraucht' text is gone) and it re-ran green; the other three pre-existing named checks re-ran green unchanged.

notes: Console error 'PushNotifications plugin is not implemented on ios' appears on every simulated-native-Capacitor check; this is an unrelated app-wide push-init side effect of the window.Capacitor shim itself, not a defect of the bonus-offer feature.
Per spec_deviations, actual AdMob playback/reward granting was not exercised; only dialog visibility/timing/content and reopen affordances were verified.

fishing-daily-limit-reached-mocked.mjs was updated (old assertion referenced stale German/English wording) per the regression row's explicit instruction; this is a corrected test expectation, not an app bug.

Matrix had 7 criteria (incl. the explicit regression row); all 7 covered with 7 browser-check artifacts (no pure-API-only criterion required a separate backend test - all are UI-surfaced via the fishing screen).
